problem: Trios Git and Mesh tabs did not expose the authoritative tri-net delivery state, so the merged PR, exact merge identity, current main head, and security-related follow-up work were invisible or easy to confuse.
solution: Added one shared live GitHub snapshot store with a verified offline fallback and one reusable repository status card. Git Repos and Mesh Status now show PR #89 as merged with 263 commits at 5b147bf, keep the moving main head separate, link recent commits, and preserve a delivery-focus summary for security, spam hardening, listener fuzzing, and BWE recovery.
lesson: A merged PR is an immutable delivery fact while main is a moving runtime fact. Presenting them from one shared source prevents stale duplication, and a derived focus summary keeps important security and resilience work visible as new commits push older highlights down the timeline.
